SELECT
  f.dsc_modelo AS modelo,
  SUM(CAST(g.num_marc_final AS DECIMAL) - CAST(g.num_marc_inicial AS DECIMAL)) AS quilometragem_rodada,
  f.num_anofabricacao AS ano_aquisicao,
  SUM(CAST(g.num_quant_utilizada AS DECIMAL)) AS consumo_combustivel,
  CAST(SUM(CAST(g.num_marc_final AS DECIMAL) - CAST(g.num_marc_inicial AS DECIMAL)) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(g.num_quant_utilizada AS DECIMAL)), 0) AS consumo_medio_km_l,
  f.dsc_lotacao AS lotacao
FROM frota_gastoFrota g
JOIN frota_frota f
  ON g.seq_veiculo = f.seq_veiculo
WHERE g.ano_referencia = 2025
  AND COALESCE(f.dsc_marca, '') NOT ILIKE '%DIVERSOS%'
  AND COALESCE(f.dsc_num_placa, '') NOT IN ('-1', 'NÃO INFORMADO')
GROUP BY f.dsc_modelo, f.num_anofabricacao, f.dsc_lotacao
LIMIT 50;
